Schnittstelle ChangeDetector<T extends @Nullable Object>

Typparameter:
T - the type of the stateful object
@API(status=EXPERIMENTAL, since="1.7.0") public interface ChangeDetector<T extends @Nullable Object>
A change detector is used to determine if a stateful object has changed after the application of a transformer. This can become improve shrinking of chains and actionChains.
